decision.name: THREE_OUTPUT_ATOMICITY_CONTRACT_SCOPE_CORRECTION
source_evidence: runner.run_once publishes latest.json, audit_latest.json, anata_latest.json using three independent atomic_write_json calls; interleaving can produce mixed as_of_ms

Capital Flow README explicitly designates cf-anata-handoff-v1 as the validated Anata-facing contract; legacy compact cf-output-v1 and rich audit are for compatibility/audit, not documented as a transactional triple
Public branch tree has no identified consumer that jointly reads all three files; this does not establish absence of a private consumer
decision.finding: Previous unconditional three-file generation-coherence acceptance criterion was too broad. It is a useful optional consistency test, but a RED result alone does not establish a violated Anata-facing contract unless a real consumer requires atomic cross-file snapshots. Do not call it a confirmed production defect or block promotion solely on speculative triple-file atomicity.
decision.improved_test_contract: On an authorized exact-SHA isolated checkout, keep the existing no-network A/B interleaving test as characterization (S seed, A paused after latest.json, B completes, release A, record transient/final generations). Separately identify a real consumer and its required read set. If consumer reads only anata_latest.json, assert single-file atomic JSON visibility and matching as_of_ms for that handoff; if consumer actually requires all three as one transaction, promote cross-file equality to a hard acceptance and capture deterministic RED evidence. No source modification in Planner A.
additional_gates: Independent targeted reader/writer pytest and full Capital Flow pytest not run; retain C quality gate
Orphan PID-only lock remains fail-closed; require documented operator-only no-live-owner and JSONL integrity verification, never auto-reap
Do not enqueue Gemini until structured JSON reliability proven and executable, consumer-backed defect established
decision.next_feasible_recovery: Obtain authorized disposable checkout pinned to c4b6a75b904644c9f51b849032a332bfaebfad94; run python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_archive_reader_writer_visibility.py and python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests; identify actual handoff consumer read contract before treating three-file test RED as a correctness defect.
